rules.statement: A creditor cannot sue under section 247 of the Civil Procedure Code to establish a claim for another, such as a mortgagor's title by prescriptive possession.
rules.supporting_quote: "The words are limited to his claim and prima facie relating to his own personal claim in and for his own personal rights have no words added thereto, which would give them this larger effect of establishing a claim for another, although in its other parts the section is so suggestive of and helpful to establish a claim through another."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 247 of the Civil Procedure Code
